snippet.title: Coal Duty | Early Access Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Coal Duty, a 1–5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy from Corecrew Games. You and your crew head down into procedurally generated mines, try to hit the State's coal quota, and plan your escape over proximity voice chat, where whatever is waiting in the next tunnel can hear you too.

Coal Duty is out now in Early Access on Steam.
➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4272370/Coal_Duty/
